newsitem.title: USA: Millennium Chemicals sells offshore unit.
newsitem.headline: Millennium Chemicals sells offshore unit.

text.p: Millennium Chemicals Inc said Friday it has sold an offshore company, which primarily holds dollar-denominated deposits, for about $38 million in cash.

The sales proceeds, which approximate the company's book value, will be used primarily to reduce existing bank debt. The company became part of the Millennium Chemicals group in connection with the October 1996 spin-off from Hanson Plc.

"Over the last two months, we are very pleased to have sold several offshore companies, freeing-up cash of approximately $343 million and reducing both our gross debt and our gross debt to total capitalization ratio," chief executive William M. Landuyt said.
